items.description: NULLWAKENullWake is a psychological horror game about isolation, uncertainty, and the slow collapse of reality.You wake up in an abandoned hospital.The building feels familiar, almost safe — until small details begin to feel wrong.Lights flicker. Corridors stretch longer than they should.The world does not break all at once. It erodes.As you move forward, the environment changes around you.A deserted town. Empty streets. Mannequins standing where no one should be.Locations blend together, as if different worlds are overlapping.NullWake does not explain everything.It lets you notice what should not exist.Fear here is not constant — it waits.ATMOSPHERE OVER ACTIONThe horror in NullWake is built on tension, silence, and expectation.There are moments where nothing happens.Those moments are intentional.Enemies do not follow predictable rules.Sometimes the safest option is to stop moving.Sometimes stopping is the worst choice you can make.A FRAGMENTED STORYThe story is told through environments, visual clues, and subtle changes in the world.Not everything you see can be trusted.Reality shifts slowly, and the game never tells you exactly when it happens.FEATURESPsychological horror focused on atmosphere and tensionMultiple interconnected locationsUnpredictable enemy behaviorEnvironmental storytellingA slow, oppressive pacing inspired by classic horror experiencesNullWake is not loud.It does not rush you.It waits for you to realize that something is wrong.And by then, it is already too late. items.description: Zereoton Hauntings 3 is a 2D survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Mateo who loves to investigate the various haunted locations in the US.Mateo, the paranormal enthusiast, got a call from a family living in Kentucky who have been experiencing paranormal activity for the past few months and were concerned about the safety of their kids. The house was built during the early 2000s, and there have been no reports of deaths on that property to date. As a result, the family was confused and couldn't understand why the paranormal activities started occurring in their home. The owner shared his experience with Mateo before the beginning of the investigation. He said that his son was so scared that he refused to sleep alone in his room because he saw a tall, black shadow man calling out his name every night. Initially, he didn't believe him until he too saw a tall, dark creature in the basement area of the home. The family completely stopped entering the basement area ever since that day. One day, his wife was sleeping in her bed and she felt her bed being shaken violently by an unseen force which woke her up from sleep. She got so scared that she had to immediately leave the house without a second thought and had to spend the rest of the night in her car. After the incident, she refused to stay in the house alone. The owner also reported hearing disembodied laughs and footsteps in the hallway area, and witnessing multiple floating orbs and shadow figures. Finally, the owner decided to get in touch with Mateo so that he could provide him with some answers. You play as Mateo, the paranormal enthusiast, and will you be able to escape the haunted house safely?Key Features:Explore the entire family house in Kentucky!Come face-to-face with the unrest spirits!Collect items like keys, golden ring, flower vase etc.Avoid traps like fire, rotating blades, spikes etc.Explore unknown spirit dimension!Nearly half-an hour of paranormal investigation.Warning:This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. items.description: [h1]Humans broke the world. The appliances are taking it back.[/h1][/p]When the grid went down for the last time, the humans grabbed what they could carry and ran. They left everything else behind - including the appliances that had served them for decades. Plugged in. Switched on. Forgotten.Now the toasters remember. The kettles remember. The vacuum cleaners remember. And the fridge has been keeping a list.Rust Lords: Appliance Uprising is a 2D belt-scrolling beat-em-up powered by Saturday-morning cartoon energy and post-apocalyptic spite. Pick a playable appliance hero, dust off your decades of unused circuitry, and reclaim the wasteland one back-alley brawl at a time.FOUR PLAYABLE HEROES. FOUR ATTITUDES.TOAST-R - Fast, hot, and always ready to pop. Speed-class melee with a flame-ejection special that launches enemies into next week.VAXX - Suck it up, spit it out, clean 'em up. Range-class brawler whose vacuum-attack draws enemies in and fires debris back as projectiles.KETTLE - Bring it to the boil. Mid-range pressure cooker who builds heat across the fight, releases it in a single scalding steam-burst that punches through whole enemy lines.FRIDGEMAN - Cold as ice. Tough as steel. Leftovers? No thanks. Tank-class heavy hitter with an ice-shatter ground pound and the slowest movement speed in the cast.FEATURES[/p]Seven hand-painted stages across the collapsed wasteland - from the abandoned suburb of Stage 1 to the rust-cathedral final showdown.Distinct movesets for every hero - light combos, heavy attacks, jump attacks, themed specials. No two appliances play the same.Couch co-op (COMING SOON - post-launch update) - up to four players, hot-swap mid-stage, friendly fire optional.Comic-book combat - POW, WHAM, BZZZT, OVERHEAT and 8 more impact effects layered over every hit.Themed boss appliances - face down Chef Kilowatt, the rogue induction stove who decided the wasteland needed seasoning.Pixel-perfect controls - keyboard + mouse, full controller support, remappable input.A wasteland soundtrack - dirty synths and broken radio static.A LOVE LETTER TO THE GENREIf you grew up on Streets of Rage, Final Fight, Castle Crashers or Scott Pilgrim vs. The World, Rust Lords is built for you. We took the belt-scroller's tight 2D combat, paired it with painted environments that pull from post-apocalyptic indie comics, and let the absurd premise carry the rest.THE APPLIANCES ARE WATCHINGWishlist now. items.description: What is Zulup? You play the role of a ball moving on the inside of a circle. Along the way, collect regularly appearing points. As you gain points, extraneous balls appear nearby, which differ from your ball in size and speed. Their task is to catch you and ruin your game. You can jump on the opposite side of the circle to avoid a collision or destroy another ball by hitting it exactly and thereby make the playing field a little freer. Your task is to score the most points without hitting other balls. Additional excitement will add a leaderboard and achievements.
